exercises.title: Define interior and closure
exercises.objective: Use open subsets and closed supersets respectively.

exercises.title: Define density and clopen sets
exercises.objective: Connect universal closure and simultaneous openness/closedness.

checks.lean:
example : T6.MyClosed LeanCraftGame.Topology.sierpinski {false} := by
  have h : LeanCraftGame.Topology.sierpinski.IsOpen {true} := Or.inr rfl
  unfold T6.MyClosed
  convert h using 1 <;> ext b <;> cases b <;> simp
checks.message: In Sierpiński space `{false}` must be closed because its complement is `{true}`, which is open.

checks.lean:
example : T6.Dense (LeanCraftGame.Topology.indiscrete Nat) {0} := by
  unfold T6.Dense
  apply Set.eq_univ_of_forall
  intro x C hC
  rcases hC with ⟨hclosed, hsub⟩
  change (LeanCraftGame.Topology.indiscrete Nat).IsOpen Cᶜ at hclosed
  rcases hclosed with h | h
  · have hc : C = Set.univ := by rw [← compl_compl C, h]; simp
    rw [hc]
    exact Set.mem_univ x
  · have hc : C = ∅ := by rw [← compl_compl C, h]; simp
    have hz : (0 : Nat) ∈ C := hsub rfl
    rw [hc] at hz
    exact hz.elim
checks.message: In an indiscrete space, every nonempty set is dense: only `univ` is a closed superset.

checks.lean: example {α : Type*} (τ : LeanCraftGame.Topology.MyTopology α) (s : Set α) : T6.MyInterior τ s ⊆ s := by intro x hx; rcases Set.mem_sUnion.mp hx with ⟨U, hU, hxU⟩; exact hU.2 hxU
checks.message: The interior is a union only of open sets contained in `s`, so it must be contained in `s`.

checks.lean: example {α : Type*} (τ : LeanCraftGame.Topology.MyTopology α) (s t : Set α) (hst : s ⊆ t) : T6.MyClosure τ s ⊆ T6.MyClosure τ t := by intro x hx C hC; exact hx C ⟨hC.1, hst.trans hC.2⟩
checks.message: Closure must be monotone: every closed superset of `t` is also a closed superset of `s`.

hints.hint: Use `⋂₀ {C | MyClosed τ C ∧ s ⊆ C}`, not the interior formula.
